questions.stem: After an accident, a patient is admitted in the emergency department with deep wounds and severe bleeding. The patient complained of pain in the left hypochondriac and left lumbar region . On examination, it was found that the direction of the wound is from the posterior abdominal wall nearer to the median plane at L1 vertebral level. As an intern, what is your diagnosis about the structure damaged and the artery involved in bleeding?

options.label: D
options.text: Body of stomach; left gastric artery
